dataset: ISO 19650-governed megaprojects and their audited outcomes
description: The largest capital projects with a documented ISO 19650 or predecessor information mandate, with original and final budgets, schedule slip and the source that records them.
author: Ivan Shtaer
source_article: The Dark Side of BIM: The Biggest ISO 19650 Failures
note: Overruns are recorded, not attributed. None of these audits isolates the contribution of the information-management mandate to the outcome; the finding is the absence of an independently audited success, not proof of causation.

cases.client: Department for Transport & Transport for London
cases.delivery: Crossrail Ltd — tunnels BFK (BAM Nuttall/Ferrovial/Kier) and Dragados–Sisk; trains Bombardier (Class 345)
cases.evidence_basis: UK government review: Department for Transport and Infrastructure and Projects Authority
cases.primary_source: Sponsoring a Major Project — The Crossrail Experience (Crown copyright, 2024)
cases.caveat: Twice award-winning for BIM. The common data environment was archived after handover; the single source of truth did not survive into operation.
cases.source_article: The Dark Side of BIM: The Biggest ISO 19650 Failures (Solebo, 2026)

cases.delivery: HS2 Ltd — civils JVs SCS Railways, Align, EKFB, BBV
cases.evidence_basis: National Audit Office; Public Accounts Committee; Stewart review; DfT reset statement (19 May 2026)
cases.caveat: The project's own Learning Legacy presents information management as a success.
cases.source_article: The Dark Side of BIM: The Biggest ISO 19650 Failures (Solebo, 2026)

cases.delivery: JVs led by Vinci, Eiffage, Bouygues TP
cases.evidence_basis: Cour des comptes (French supreme audit institution)
cases.primary_source: Cour des comptes, La Société du Grand Paris
cases.caveat: Audited at programme level; BIM is not separately isolated as a cause.
cases.source_article: The Dark Side of BIM: The Biggest ISO 19650 Failures (Solebo, 2026)

cases.evidence_basis: NSW Government Sydney Metro Review — Interim Report (2023) and Final Report (2023–24)
cases.caveat: Programme-level audit; the digital engineering mandate is documented, its contribution to the overrun is not isolated.
cases.source_article: The Dark Side of BIM: The Biggest ISO 19650 Failures (Solebo, 2026)

cases.client: North East Link Authority / Major Road Projects Victoria
cases.delivery: Spark consortium (Webuild, CPB, GS E&C, China Construction Oceania)
cases.evidence_basis: Victoria's Big Build / state programme reporting
cases.caveat: State programme reporting rather than an independent audit of the digital mandate.
cases.source_article: The Dark Side of BIM: The Biggest ISO 19650 Failures (Solebo, 2026)

cases.schedule_slip: Staged opening; full line delayed to 2026
cases.evidence_basis: NSW Government Sydney Metro Review — Interim Report (2023) and Final Report (2023–24)
cases.caveat: As above: programme-level audit, BIM contribution not isolated.
cases.source_article: The Dark Side of BIM: The Biggest ISO 19650 Failures (Solebo, 2026)

cases.delivery: Cross Yarra Partnership (Lendlease, John Holland, Bouygues)
cases.primary_source: VAGO, Metro Tunnel Project: Phase 3 — Systems Integration, Testing and Commissioning
cases.caveat: State audit office; the VDAS mandate is documented, causation is not attributed.
cases.source_article: The Dark Side of BIM: The Biggest ISO 19650 Failures (Solebo, 2026)

cases.standard: CIC BIM Standards (Hong Kong's national annex to ISO 19650; CIC v2, Dec 2020)
cases.primary_source: South China Morning Post, Final cost of Hong Kong's scandal-hit rail link
cases.caveat: Corner-cutting and missing-records scandal; the records failure is the point, not the percentage.
cases.source_article: The Dark Side of BIM: The Biggest ISO 19650 Failures (Solebo, 2026)

cases.delivery: JVs — Ferrovial–Laing O'Rourke; Costain–Vinci–Bachy; BAM–Morgan Sindall–Balfour Beatty
cases.evidence_basis: Trade press reporting of the regulated cost position
cases.primary_source: Construction News, Tideway tunnel cost grows again to GBP 4.5bn (2023)
cases.caveat: Not an independent audit of the information mandate; cited as a cost record.
cases.source_article: The Dark Side of BIM: The Biggest ISO 19650 Failures (Solebo, 2026)

cases.client: City Rail Link Ltd (NZ Government and Auckland Council)
cases.delivery: Link Alliance (Vinci CGP, Downer, Soletanche Bachy, WSP, AECOM, Tonkin+Taylor)
cases.evidence_basis: Public cost reporting; digital engineering documented by the alliance partner
cases.primary_source: Downer, Digital Engineering — City Rail Link
cases.caveat: Delivery-side documentation of the BIM mandate; no independent audit isolating it.
cases.source_article: The Dark Side of BIM: The Biggest ISO 19650 Failures (Solebo, 2026)

cases.primary_source: NAO, Investigation into the rescue of Carillion's PFI hospital contracts
cases.caveat: Contractor insolvency is the dominant cause; included as a BIM-era record, not as a BIM-caused overrun.
cases.source_article: The Dark Side of BIM: The Biggest ISO 19650 Failures (Solebo, 2026)
